title: Know when a person presses the button, so the firmware can react

interface.what: configure the button pin and its detection (interrupt or ADC) once at boot
read and clear the 'a press happened' flag set by the detection (taken atomically)
the number of accepted presses since boot

hal_contract.name: button_pull
hal_contract.what: the pull that holds the button line high: the internal pull-up (interrupt routes) or an external pull-up resistor (analog route, internal pull-up off)

hal_contract.name: button_detect_registers
hal_contract.what: the registers that enable the detection: PCMSKn / PCICR / PCIFR (pin-change), ADMUX / ADCSRA / DIDR0 (analog) - from cited RegisterField rows

hal_contract.name: debounce_ms
hal_contract.what: the lockout debounce: a press is accepted at most once per debounce window (the Purpose criterion debounce_ms)

hal_contract.name: button_line
hal_contract.what: the line the button closes to ground, read as a pin change or as an ADC level below a threshold

hal_contract.name: press_flag
hal_contract.what: the flag and counter written in the detection context and read in the loop: read under ATOMIC_BLOCK

notes: Rebuilt 2026-10-18 from the README, board.custom.button_routes and the templates (the first copies were never committed: the repo ignores *.json by default).
